import leafmap

map = leafmap.Map(
  center=[42.8, -76.0],
  draw_control=False,
  layers_control=True,
  zoom=8)

leafmap.csv_to_geojson(
  "data/cny_churches_2026.csv",
  "data/cny_churches_2026.geojson",
  latitude="Latitude",
  longitude="Longitude"
)

map.add_marker_cluster(
  "data/cny_churches_2026.geojson",
  x="Longitude",
  y="Latitude",
  popup=["Name",
         "Address",
         "Website"],
  layer_name="CNY Churches2" 
)
